Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) The contract period may be extended for up to one additional year, on the same rat es, terms and conditions, subject to satisfactory performance of the service provider a nd mutual consent of both parties. (2) There will be no mid-term escalation in the contract rate during the entire contract peroid. (3) Any extra usage charges shall be governed and paid strictly in accordance with the applicable GeM Service Level Agreements (SLAs). (4) The Service Provider will create Logs for each Service rendered. Before generation of the Bill, the Log-Sheet for the relevant billing period will be verified/ signed by Buyer/Consignee.

(5) The seller would arrange and submit to the buyer, valid Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) in r espect of each of the drivers deployed for duty under the vehicle hiring contract. (6) Due to nature of work handled by this ministry, the duties of the vehicle/ driver may routinel y extend to odd hours and on week-ends/holidays. (7) The buyer reserves the right to technically disqualify any bidder who has earlier been award ed GeM contract(s) and the bidder on the basis of its earlier adverse experience with the bidder a nd/or inputs received by it w.r.t. the quality of service, unprofessional behavior, etc. (8) The seller shall not subcontract the contract, in whole or in part, to any entity in any form. Al l vehicles must be registered under the name of a single service provider; subleasing or registrati on under individual ownership is strictly prohibited. A copy of the RC of vehicles provided by the s ervice provider need to be provided at the time of start of service. Any violation of this provision will result in withdrawal of the affected vehicle and penalties. Further non-compliance may lead t o raising incidents against the service provider and debarring of the service provider for any futu re contract with the Ministry. (9) The vehicles provided under this contract will be strictly prohibited from any form of private renting. (10) At the financial stage of bid evaluation, the L1 bidder may be sought for clarification/justific ation of detailed price analysis of its bid price in relation to scope, schedule, allocation of risks an d responsibilities, and any other requirements of the bids document. If, after evaluation the price analyses the bidder fails to demonstrate its capability to deliver the contract at the offered price t he bidder may be disqualified at financial stage. (11) All participant/bidders must submit a vehicle maintenance undertaking that vehicles provid ed will be regularly serviced by the Service Provider and relevant documents needs to be furnishe d to this office if required. (12) All participant/bidders must submit an undertaking to provide all the necessary compliances /invoices/documents required under GST legislation for enabling Government to avail Input tax (G ST) credit. Offers not accompanied with the above undertaking will be summarily rejected. (13) All participant/bidders must submit an undertaking on the company’s letter head and duly s igned by the signatory of the bid that all the documents/certificates/information submitted by the m are genuine. The bidder should neither be blacklisted by any Govt. Department nor should any criminal case against the agency, or its owner or partner anywhere in India. Bidders have to sub mit undertaking to this effect as part of technical bid documents. (14) Participation in this bid will imply that the bidder has accepted all the terms & conditions an d subsequent modifications, if any, of this bid document. (15) The firm is required to provide the Notarized Bid Security declaration form (signed by the rel evant authority) stating that if they withdraw or modify their bids during the period of validity, or if they are awarded the contract and they fail to submit a performance security, they will be susp ended for the one year from being eligible to submit Bids/Proposals for contracts with this organiz ation. In addition, the firm is also required to give the consent for raising an incident in GeM porta l against the seller for noncompliance of the same. (16) The Service Provider must provide vehicles in excellent condition (Up to 25,000 Kms travell ed) at the beginning of the contract period. An undertaking in this effect is to be uploaded by the bidder. Bidder to upload bid specific undertaking to this effect on its official letter head. (17) The Service Provider should ensure that the drivers deployed are familiar with routes of imp ortant Offices for any duty assigned by competent authority. The driver of the vehicle must have working smartphone for easy contact by officials. The driver shall be reachable at all times. He m ust have an active internet connection at all times where Google map can be accessed. He must have a basic understanding of Maps/GPS/Navigation. No driver should be changed without prior i ntimation. (18) The drivers of the vehicles must possess valid driver license and must have a minimum 05 years of experience of driving vehicle. The drivers must wear the designated uniform provided by service provider. The drivers must have a basic understanding of Hindi, English, and the local lan guage. The drivers must not be under the influence of alcohol or any intoxicating substances duri ng duty hours

(19) All participant/bidders must submit an undertaking that all the Terms & Conditions of bid ar e accepted by the bidder including GeM GTC, Scope of Work, Special Contract Conditions and Bid Specific ATC etc. (20) The buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any or all proposals without assigning any r easons. No tenders shall have any cause or claim against the Buyer for rejection of their proposal .
